name: Machine Seated Crunch
grip: Hands holding upper chest handles or shoulder harness straps beside the neck.
description: Flex the spine forward against a padded chest lever or harness while seated on an abdominal machine, curling the ribcage toward the pelvis against adjustable stack resistance.
setup: Select the desired weight stack pin load.
Adjust the seat height so the machine's pivot axis aligns directly with your lumbar/thoracic flexion zone (mid-torso).
Sit firmly with your lower back against the lumbar pad, feet secured behind roller pads or flat on foot rests.
Grasp the overhead handles or place the padded chest harness against your upper chest/shoulders.
instructions: Exhale and flex your spine forward, curling your ribcage down toward your pelvis.
Focus all movement on curling the upper torso into a tight ball using only abdominal contraction.
Hold the fully crunched position for a brief moment of peak contraction.
Inhale and reverse the motion slowly under complete control, allowing your spine to unroll back to an upright position without hyperextending.
cues: Pull your ribs down to your hip bones.
Do not pull with your arms or neck.
Control the unrolling on the way back.
commonMistakes: Pulling with the arms and shoulders instead of curling with the abdominals.
Hinging purely at the hip flexors with a flat back instead of flexing the spine.
Allowing the weight plates to slam into the stack between reps.

logging.example: Weight pin set to 40 kg: record 40 kg selected machine load.
logging.note: Cam profiles and lever mechanics vary between manufacturers; record the selected stack pin load.

variantNote: Selectorized seated crunch machine providing a direct, progressive resistance curve for spinal flexion that cannot be easily achieved with bodyweight floor crunches.
